questions.q: What does a drilldown action do?
options: Lets a user click a plus/minus toggle to interactively show or hide part of the same report
Automatically emails a report on a schedule
Embeds one report inside another as a fixed sub-object
Opens a completely separate report when a value is clicked
questions.explain: A drilldown action expands or collapses content already in the report — nothing new is requested from the server. That's what makes it different from a drillthrough, which opens a separate report.

questions.q: Which two properties actually make a drilldown action work?
options: DocumentMapLabel and Bookmark
Hidden and ToggleItem
Visible and BorderStyle
Action and Value
questions.explain: Hidden controls whether the item shows when the report first runs; ToggleItem names the text box a user clicks to flip that Hidden state.

questions.q: What is the "containing-scope rule" for a toggle text box?
options: The toggle text box must be in the same group as the hidden item, or in an ancestor group above it — never inside the item it's hiding
The toggle text box must always be in the report header
There is no such rule — any text box in the report can toggle any item
The toggle text box must be a different data type than the hidden item
questions.explain: A toggle text box that lives inside the group it controls isn't offered as a valid ToggleItem — it has to sit in the same group as the hidden item or a containing (parent) group.

questions.q: How does the Excel rendering extension handle items with a Hidden/ToggleItem drilldown configured?
options: It refuses to render the report at all
It expands and displays everything — all rows and columns render visible regardless of Hidden
It deletes the hidden rows and columns entirely from the workbook
It behaves identically to the HTML viewer, respecting the toggle
questions.explain: The show/hide toggle only works in interactive rendering extensions like HTML. Excel instead expands and shows every row and column, regardless of the Hidden setting.

questions.q: What's the key difference between a drilldown and a drillthrough report?
options: A drillthrough is only available in Power BI, not SSRS
A drilldown always requires a parameter; a drillthrough never does
There is no real difference — they're two names for the same feature
A drilldown expands/collapses content in place; a drillthrough opens a separate report
questions.explain: Drilldown toggles visibility within the current report. Drillthrough, covered in Lesson 27, navigates to a genuinely separate report instead.
